execution_abort_session.note: Closes a session and records it. Stays separate from the read tools (section 4.2).

execution_advance_session.note: Needs callables that MCP cannot send. No MCP use today.

execution_build_divergence_record.note: Builds a record and writes nothing. The only arguments MCP can send are useless.

execution_create_recorder.note: Builds an object. The result is only a text label over MCP.

execution_reconcile_session.note: Writes the calibration counts and the session after a night.

observatory_equipment_apply_configuratio.note: The backend calls it after the settings page saves. It points the INDI session at a host, so it is not offered to the AI.

observatory_equipment_connect.note: Opens the INDI session. Not a device command, but the status tools already open it on demand.

observatory_equipment_disconnect.note: Closes the INDI session. Not a device command, but it would cut off monitoring and has no monitoring use.

observatory_equipment_set_active_camera.note: Writes the active camera into the configuration file.

observatory_equipment_set_active_telesco.note: Writes the active telescope into the configuration file.

observatory_equipment_set_device_propert.note: Sets a raw INDI property, which commands a device. Belongs to the dropped control side.

observatory_equipment_status.note: Reads the active equipment, camera profiles, site, commissioning records and the INDI device list. The INDI sections use the connect-only path.

observatory_guiding_expose.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_guiding_refit_spectrum.note: Recomputes and stores a result. The user does not want an AI to trigger it.

observatory_guiding_run_loop.note: Runs the guide loop until a stop event MCP cannot send is set; the backend runs it on a thread. Sends guide pulses, which belongs to the dropped control side.

observatory_guiding_status.note: Reads the saved guider calibration, the mount's periodic error model and the guide plate scale (no device needed), and with include=['live'] the guiding going on now and its RMS error.

observatory_guiding_stop_loop.note: Ends the guide loop through a stop event MCP cannot send. Dropped with the other hardware tools.

observatory_imaging_capture_image.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_imaging_focus_move.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_imaging_set_filter.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_imaging_status.interim_block: The filters and focuser sections return [] and 0 because the MCP process has no hardware connection. Use app_status with the telescope section (focuser position, filter, pier side, tracking).
observatory_imaging_status.note: Reads the filter names, the focuser position and the saved focus model.

observatory_mount_abort_motion.note: Commands the mount, so it is dropped with the other hardware tools.

observatory_mount_cancel_centering.note: Stops a centering run by aborting the mount, so it is dropped with the other hardware tools.

observatory_mount_get_polar_alignment.note: The backend shows it. An AI reads the stored runs through review_query(kind="alignment").

observatory_mount_manual_move.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_park.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_poll_external_alignmen.note: The backend calls it to store the syncs other programs queued. It writes records, and the AI is read-only.

observatory_mount_set_slew_rate.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_set_tracking.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_slew.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_mount_status.interim_block: Connects through connect_to_telescope, which sends CONNECTION=ON to every INDI device that is off. Blocked until it uses the connect-only path. app_status reports the mount through the backend.
observatory_mount_status.note: Reads the mount, filter, focuser and camera temperature. Blocked for now; see the block.

observatory_mount_unpark.note: Commanding a device (mount, cameras, focuser, filter wheel, enclosure) is out of scope. Reading from them and from the Pi is allowed.

observatory_remote_frame_status.note: Built 2026-10-04. Counts a target's frames at the telescope, on the drive and in the library, and names the frames that are in one place but not the next. Reads only.

observatory_remote_list.note: Lists folders or files on the telescope computer. Reads only.

observatory_remote_sync_frames.note: Built 2026-10-03; since 2026-10-05 it also copies calibration folders, every folder, chosen files and a local folder. The AI may ingest frames from the telescope: adds, never deletes.

observatory_remote_sync_logs.note: Built 2026-10-03. The AI may ingest the guide and Ekos logs: adds or updates records, never deletes.

observatory_safety_apply_promotion_decis.note: Applies an operator's decision. Needs the operator.

observatory_safety_enter_controller_mode.note: Writes the delegation state (the Safe Mode toggle) to the database. Not a hardware command, but the user decided an AI may not change configuration.

observatory_safety_enter_monitoring_mode.note: Writes the delegation state (the Safe Mode toggle) to the database. Not a hardware command, but the user decided an AI may not change configuration.

observatory_safety_status.interim_block: The assessment section connects through connect_to_telescope, which sends CONNECTION=ON to every INDI device that is off, and enclosure_state returns unknown in the MCP process. Blocked until those sections use the connect-only path.
observatory_safety_status.note: Reads the safety rules, a weather verdict, the enclosure, the delegation policy and the agreement evidence for one capability. The delegation policy's live row was once written by a UI test; clean it before relying on it.

planning_add_checklist_items.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_add_to_queue.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_build_deep_star_catalog.note: Downloads from Gaia for hours and writes the catalog database.

planning_calculate_panels.note: Works out mosaic panel centers. Saves nothing.

planning_create_mosaic.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_create_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_create_sequence.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_create_session.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_dismiss_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_get_advisory.note: Built 2026-10-06; split 2026-10-31. The target dataset report (quality) or the trust in one star result, worked out on demand. Saves nothing. Moves to the review group.

planning_get_calibration_advice.note: How many calibration frames of one kind the library holds, worked out on demand. Saves nothing.

planning_get_constellation_lines.note: Draws the Planetarium. Returns an empty list because of a wrong file path, and is 89 KB when fixed.

planning_get_deep_catalog_status.note: Built 2026-10-06. Reads the catalog file; the optional estimate queries the Gaia archive and saves nothing.

planning_get_depth_goal.note: Built 2026-10-27 (#134). Reads a target's depth goal: the chosen level, the depth reached and the time to reach the level. Saves nothing.

planning_get_package_for_target.note: Reads the one package that stands for a target. Reads only.

planning_get_plan.note: Built 2026-10-06. Reads one recorded session, by id or by night.

planning_get_tonight_advice.note: Tonight's ranking of targets, worked out on demand. Saves nothing.

planning_get_visibility.note: Built 2026-10-03. Where objects are now or over a night: altitude, horizon clearance with caller-given blocked ranges, meridian crossing, Sun and Moon. Reads nothing stored.

planning_lookup_coordinates.note: Built 2026-10-04. The position of a named object, from the library or SIMBAD. Reads only.

planning_query_catalogs.note: Lists the catalog drivers. Reads only.

planning_query_plans.note: Lists the recorded sessions, the observation packages or the suggestion log. Reads only.

planning_query_sources.note: Targets and stars near a point from the library, SIMBAD or the online catalogs, brightest stars first, cut at a limit with the total reported. Replaces planning_find_sources, planning_get_sources, planning_get_library_star_summaries and planning_get_online_catalog_sources.

planning_refresh_suggestions.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_remove_from_queue.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_reopen_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_reorder_queue.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_set_depth_goal.note: Writes the user's chosen depth level for a target to the database. Not a hardware command, but the user decided an AI may not change configuration.

planning_set_entry_exposures.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_set_framing.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_tick_checklist_item.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_undismiss_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

planning_update_package.note: The AI is read-only, so a tool that writes is not offered.

review_frame_guiding.note: Built 2026-10-03. Cuts the stored guide-log samples to each light frame's exposure window. Reads only.

review_get_live_session_status.note: Served 2026-10-03. refresh=true copies the newest Ekos and KStars logs into a local folder, which is reading from the telescope computer and adds files only. A folder argument is now checked against the allowed roots. Reports pier side, camera temperature, exposure counts and dither settings; the guide algorithm is not in the logs and the reply says so.

review_get_performance_envelope.note: Slow: reads every session and target twice.

review_query.note: Built 2026-10-03. Reads the recorded nights and calculates the analyses, in replies under 40,000 characters. The recorded-data tables are read through the butler, which creates a missing table. Kind night_quality needs session_id (the night) and returns a typed review.

review_query_alignment_records.note: The backend reads the stored attempts for its alignment views and passes in library targets. The AI reads nights through review_query(kind="alignment").

review_query_alignment_sessions.note: The backend calls it with plate-solve attempts it has already read. The AI reads nights through review_query(kind="alignment"), which groups them already.
